adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and for collective bookings appends additional hosts’ destination calendars (`handleNewBooking.ts`: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` then loops over each destination and calls `createEvent` for that destination’s credential (`createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`). However, non-Google services shown in the diff still select the calendar ID from the *first* destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` in `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `packages/app-store/office365calendar/...`, `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/...`). Only GoogleCalendarService was updated to pick the calendar by matching `credentialId`. This mismatch means when host #2’s credential is used, O365/Lark/CalDAV still use host #1’s `externalId`, which can cause event creation to target the wrong calendar or fail for non-first hosts.
